flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code that sends a work order indicator to PLUS. Checked: ocmsadminapi (plus-* endpoints, SuspensionProcessingController, PlusIntegrationController, NoticeDetailControllerPlus), ocmsadminprivateapi (workflows/plus), thirdpartyapi, ocmsadminui (work order Report). All PLUS endpoints are inbound (PLUS calls OCMS); there is no OCMS call to PLUS and no work order indicator or validity period field
note: The story asks OCMS to send a special indicator and the work order validity period to PLUS so PLUS users know an appeal came from an offender in the work order. There is no code. The work order itself does not exist (OCMS34.13) and the notice indicator does not exist either (OCMS34.15), so there is no data to send. The PLUS integration in the repos is inbound only: PLUS calls plus-* endpoints in ocmsadminapi (for example plus-apply-suspension, plus-offence-notice-detail) and in ocmsadminprivateapi. Grep for house visit / work order / workorder across the six repos only finds the commented-out 'Workorder Reports' stub in ocmsadminui. There is no HTTP client from OCMS to PLUS (only a subscription key header in application-prod.properties:60-61 used to validate incoming requests, ocms.plus.key.validation.enabled=false). Any other mechanism outside the repos (for example PLUS reading the DB or a view directly) cannot verify from repo. The story status in stories.json is blank, so the requirement is not given and the story was traced normally. No maintenance ticket mentions work orders or this indicator.
recommendation: Not claimable yet. Nothing sends the work order indicator or validity period to PLUS, and the supporting features (work order, indicator) are not built either. Ask the team whether PLUS gets this data through a path outside the repos

steps.step: Notice di bawah ID di work order sudah diberi special indicator oleh Tagging officer (hasil OCMS34.15)
steps.detail: No work order indicator field or job exists on the notice. The only trace is the 'Workorder Reports' tab in the staff UI, inside a commented-out JSX block (ReportList.tsx:147-201). Same as OCMS34.15.

steps.step: OCMS mengirim special indicator ke PLUS
steps.detail: There is no outbound call from OCMS to PLUS for the indicator. The PLUS endpoints in ocmsadminapi are inbound: PLUS calls plus-apply-suspension (SuspensionProcessingController.java:485) and PlusIntegrationController describes 'REST APIs for PLUS Staff Portal' (:15-19). No RestTemplate/WebClient to PLUS exists for a work order indicator.

steps.step: OCMS mengirim masa berlaku work order ke PLUS
steps.detail: There is no work order validity period field on the notice or in the PLUS endpoint responses. plus-offence-notice-detail (NoticeDetailControllerPlus.java:39) is an inbound endpoint for PLUS to read notice detail; grep for work order / validity period in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi finds nothing.

steps.step: PLUS user dapat melihat apakah ada appeal dari offender yang tercantum di work order
steps.detail: Because the indicator and validity period do not exist, PLUS has no data to flag work order offenders. How PLUS shows this on its side cannot verify from repo.
